title: Non-runner package — official day-by-day itinerary (Kathmandu–Lukla–Namche–EBC–Kala Patthar)
publisher: Tenzing Hillary Everest Marathon (event organiser, Kathmandu)
claims: Day 1 (16 May): arrive Kathmandu and transfer to hotel. Day 2 (17 May): morning trek briefing and half-day sightseeing in Kathmandu, or briefing/sightseeing and drive to Ramechhap if the flight departs from Ramechhap.

Day 3 (18 May): fly to Lukla (35 min, 2,860 m), trek to Phakding (8 km, 2,652 m). Day 4 (19 May): trek to Namche Bazaar (15 km, 3,446 m). Day 5 (20 May): acclimatisation halt at Namche. Day 6 (21 May): trek to Khumjung (2.5–3 km, 3,740 m). Day 7 (22 May): Deboche via Thyangboche (6–8 km, 3,650 m).

Day 8 (23 May): trek to Dingboche (12 km, 4,358 m). Day 9 (24 May): acclimatisation halt at Dingboche. Day 10 (25 May): trek to Lobuje (9 km, 4,928 m). Day 11 (26 May): Gorakshep 5,160 m, then after lunch trek to Everest Base Camp 5,364 m and return to Gorakshep (6 km).

Day 12 (27 May): early morning hike to Kala Patthar viewpoint (2 km, 5,545 m, highest point of the trek), then trek back to Pangboche (15 km, 3,985 m). Day 14 (28 May): trek back to Namche (18 km, 3,440 m). Day 15 (29 May): marathon day, watching from the finish at Yak Parking Lot (Chaur Camp), Namche Bazaar, near the Sherpa Culture Museum.

Day 16 (30 May): afternoon trek to Monjo (8 km, 2,850 m). Day 17 (31 May): trek back to Lukla (10 km, 2,860 m). Day 18 (1 June): morning flight to Kathmandu or Ramechhap, then drive to Kathmandu. Day 19 (2 June): free day in Kathmandu. Day 20 (3 June): international departure.
